command:
set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=link.localclimate.app; DUMP="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=|firstInstallTime=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionName=2.0.10'; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionCode=20010'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PACKAGE"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; START="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity" | tr -d '')"; printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; sleep 3; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; test -n "$PID"; echo POSTCHECK_PID=$PID; echo ACTIVITY_MATCHES; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity|ResumedActivity|link.localclimate.app' | head -30 || true; echo WINDOW_FOCUS; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys window windows | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -10 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -q "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity"; if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime:.*FATAL|Process: link.localclimate.app.*has died'; then echo 'fresh-install smoke found fatal process error' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo FRESH_INSTALL_SMOKE=pass
